mapper.sql: id, title, description, difficulty, category_id, tags, initial_code, solution_code, test_cases, time_limit_ms, memory_limit_mb, success_rate as acceptance_rate, view_count, submit_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problems (title, description, difficulty, category_id, tags, initial_code, solution_code, test_cases, time_limit_ms, memory_limit_mb, success_rate, view_count, submit_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{difficulty}, #{categoryId}, #{tags}, #{initialCode}, #{solutionCode}, #{testCases}, #{timeLimitMs}, #{memoryLimitMb}, #{acceptanceRate}, #{viewCount}, #{submitCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE problems SET submit_count = submit_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE problems SET success_rate = #{rate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
